balls.text: they have got a single and come back for the second to long-on, the throw is at the striker's end, it's a tad away from the keeper who has to stretch to whip off the bails and he is just in, two to end the innings
ugly stroke from Dravid, he as looking for a slog but the ball never came on, had moved across the off stump too but is beaten, he wanted a bye too but wasn't coming
full-toss, crunched, four. Easy as it gets for the captain, through extra-cover!
leg stump lies flat on the ground as he's bowled trying to paddle it away, was a length ball and the shot was one alright, just missed it!
very full and that's driven to the wide long-off region for a single, fielded well by Das but the throw isn't the best and it goes for an overthrow
full-toss and its crunched back to the bowler, misfielded but gets it back in time
outside the off stump and it's called a wide, again slightly harsh I feel but that's how it goes in cricket sometimes
shorter in length and that's pulled away to the deep square-leg region for a single, another over that costs four
slows it down now and defended to the off side for a single
on his pads and he wants to smack it over the deep square-leg, misses, hits his pads
beaten, goes between the bat and pad and this is collected well by Bisla, appeal for stumping but he's back
fuller on the off stump and tapped away to the leg side for a single
defended on the front foot and pushed to the off side for a single
fuller on his pads and tapped away to the leg side for a single, good over that costs him only four along with the wicket
full toss on his pads and tapped down to long-on for a single
shot but caught! it was shorter in length and he looks to go down the track, hits it hard enough but straight to the long-on fielder, caught!
fuller again and driven to the off side for a single
floats it up and that's gone very wide outside the off stump, he was looking to reach after going down the track, got his bat on it, pushes it to long-off
wants to hit it through the line, gets an inside edge on to the pads, not for a run
does not bowl too full yet again and it's pushed to Gambhir at point
and another shorter one, flatter too, pushed to the off side
and now four through point, he was trying to cut it away and it comes off the middle of the bat
punches it down to the long-off area for a single
pushed to the leg side for a single
how do you drop that? yep, that's dropped and I am shocked! that's the easiest one, top edged to one that's shorter and it pops up to Bisla and he reverse cups it, dropped!
very full this time and he's driven it down to the long-off region for a single
shorter in length and pushed down to the long-off region for a single
slows it down further and on a good length, tapped it to the long-on fielder for a single
fuller on the middle stump and tapped down to the off side for a single
shorter in length and punched to the long-off fielder for a single
slows it down to a trickle and he was going for an expansive shot, checks his shot and punches it to long-off for a single
shorter in length and that's cut away for a single to deep point
slightly slower, slower too and it's worked away to the leg side for another single, well played this over
another one that's not really up to the bat, and it's knocked away to long-on for a single
shorter in length again and he's on the back foot, pushed to the leg side for a single
on a length and turning away, defended very carefully to the off side
on a length and he's walking across to the off and punching through to the leg side for a single
and this is driven down the ground for a single
punched through extra-cover for a four! that's up to the bat and it's drilled away, four for the new man
flighted by the bowler, quickish spinner, and it's driven back to the bowler
fuller on the off stump and driven down to long-on for a single
down the leg side and that's probably come off the pad, or that's what the umpire thinks anyway, not called a wide
on a good length on the off stump, punched down the ground for a single
shot, clean hit over the mid-wicket region for a six! it was full enough to attempt that slog shot, but it looks graceful enough, goes all the way too, this is a very vital innings from Samson
fuller on the middle stump and it's patted back to the bowler
shorter length on the off stump and it's only pushed to the off side
on his pads and that's tapped away ever so gently to the leg side by Shah for a single
bowled him, that's gone! it was a length ball outside the off stump and he goes back to cut it, inside edge and it hits the stumps.
late cut for a four! what a shot! that was very close to the off stump and he goes back and plays it so late and so delicately, goes away
very full from the bowler and that's worked away to the leg side for a single
moves across the off stump before going back to his original stance and wants to hit it over, gets an inside edge to the leg side for a single
shortish in length and that's pulled away to the deep mid-wicket region for a single
was looking to punch it through the leg side, was on the off stump and there's some bounce on it, beaten
slows it down even further if that's possible and the batsman doesn't bat an eyelid in punching it down to long-on for a single
on a good length and as expected it's a slower one, tapped to the short cover fielder
four off the last ball, that was a cracking shot, shortish in length and the youngster opens the face of the bat and guides it through the in field for a four, races away

and now he's gone, finally an lbw given! it was shorter in length and he wanted to sweep it away, the ball never came on and he missed, hits him plumb in front and this time, there's no two ways about it for the umpire, out is the call and a very correct one
turning back into the batsman now and that's hit his pad yet again, spinning down the leg side I think, the keeper didn't appeal
defended off the back foot, pushed back to the bowler
tries to sweep it away and there's a big, big appeal, given not-out but that's looking mighty close on replays!
shorter in length and there's a bit of turn away from the bat, gets a leading edge and it rushes to the short cover
very full and that's spanked to the long-on for a couple of runs, he hits 'em hard even on this slow pitch
full-toss and that's pulled away to the mid-wicket region for a single, that's called a no-ball for height this one
fuller on the off stump and it's gone to long-on for a single
quicker on the leg stump, he was looking to pull it away, hits his pads, rolls over to the leg side
good shot for a single, moves around in his crease and cracks it over the covers, goes on the bounce to the fielder
shot back to the bowler but he's away in his follow-through and the ball hits the non-strikers stumps hard, are able to come through for a single
fuller from Kallis and that's crunched back through the left of the bowler, single to long-off
pushed to the leg side for a single now, 15 off the over to signal the Time-out
he was on the leg stump and the ball was delivered way outside the off, turning away too and still manages to cut it through
and finally Watto gets some bat on one that's gone down the leg-side! he's been letting those go for wides but this one gets a tickle that runs away to the fence for a four
fuller on the pads and that's worked away to the deep mid-wicket region for a couple of runs
fuller, as expected from the bowler now, and pushed to the leg side for a single now
shot, that's the shot of the game so far! this is a slow, slow pitch and this was slightly shorter, he was waiting and then pulls it over the deep mid-wicket region for a six!
length ball that angles back into the batsman, defended back to the bowler, not for runs
again slows it down and that's defended to the off side
that's outside the off stump and driven on the up, through to deep cover and Narine gets his foot down in time to stall it to two
slower from JK and pushed to the deep point, they are off for a quick single, bit of a misfield also helps
short of length and that's punched through the extra-cover region for a four, was a crunchy stroke that
short of length and the batsman's pushed it to the leg side for a single
fuller and pushed to the short cover, not for runs
shorter in length and wants to pull it away, gets bit of an inside edge, runs across to the deep square-leg region for a single
shorter in length and it's pushed it to the off side for a single
on his pads, on a good length and he gets his pad out and pushes it to the right of the bowler, single to the batsman
shorter in length yet again, on the middle stump and slight turn away, pushes it to the leg side for a single
shorter in length and punches it down to long-on after rocking back, for a single
up to the bat outside the off stump and that's driven to mid-off for a single
outside the off stump and he wants to cut it away, misses and it's called a wide, harshly so if I may add
he was moving towards the off stump while playing the shot and the delivery was on his pads, gets some bat on it and flicks to the leg side
shorter in length and that's rocked back and punched down the ground for a single
and now for the slog, misses, the keeper collects it well
short of length and he wants to cut it, no pace on the ball, nothing on the shot, to short cover
down the leg side and he wants to sweep, misses, wide called
up and over and for a single, there's a long-on in place and he wants to test him, fuller in length and he gets his foot out and plays through the line, bounces away to the fielder
shorter and turns away from the bat, flicked away to the deep square-leg region for a single
and now gets his bat and pad out, defends back to the bowler again
that's fuller and he's played it off the back foot, pushed back to the bowler, just falls short

gone, soft dismissal, caught at short point! I think I am going to say this a lot today, it's a soft dismissal, he was looking to play forward but gets an outside edge and it's gone straight to the fielder close in, two down
fuller on the off stump, and that's driven to long-off for a single
fuller on the middle stump and driven back to the bowler
opens the face of the bat and guides it through to short third-man for a single
poor ball, it was short, and it was flat, he thought Watto would come down but he rocks back and smashes it through mid-wicket for a four
fuller on the off stump, driven down to long-on for a single
fuller on the middle stump, flicked it away to short mid-wicket
short of length and patted back to the bowler

and gone now, Rahane has been dismissed, stumped off a very slower ball from the spinner! he really slowed that up and Rahane was looking to hit it over the top, he misses and Bisla whips off the bails
and now he's beaten the man at deep square-leg and got himself his second four, was a length ball on the middle stump and he clears his front foot and smack he goes!
up and over and for a four, it was fuller outside the off stump and it did have some width, not hit hard, but placed well
and another one, tries the slower one yet again but he's lost his line and it's called a wide, the fielder is up in the circle at fine-leg
poor ball down the leg side, it went further down and it's gone for a wide
on his pads and that's flicked away straight to short fine-leg, a few inches each side would have seen it run away, that's the second shot that could have gone to the fence this over
chips down the track and just pushes it to the mid-on fielder for a quick single, Watson was slow in getting away but in the end makes it easily
slightly closer to the middle stumps and that's tapped away to the leg side for a single
short of length, outside the off and that's spanked but straight to the point fielder, not for runs
and now he plays an aggressive sweep across the line, well hit but straight to the deep mid-wicket fielder who's there for this favourite slog-sweep of Watson
goes down the track and wants to hit it over, does not get it off the middle and it goes to long-on
fuller this time from the bowler and he has to tap it away to the leg side, there's a short mid-wicket in place
fuller on the off stump and that's defended back to the off side
on his pads and he was first looking to come forward but then flicks it off the back foot to the leg side
round the stumps and defended off the back foot, back to the bowler
outside the off stump, it's on a good length and he opens the face of the bat and pushes into the covers, not for runs though
and back to defending it off the back foot, it was again on the off stump but keeps low yet again, tapped back
hoicked over mid-wicket for a four! shot, that was not very full but he goes across the line and over the in-field to the fence
this one bounces a tad more, outside the off stump and on a good length, pushed into the covers
and immediately the ball keeps low, he was looking to come out of the crease and then had to get back down in time, defends back
swing away from the bat and he opens the face of the bat through to third-man for a single
full-toss and that's hit over the bowler's head for a four to finish off the game!
goes for a sweep and that one from Hogg lands on the spot he wanted, wrong 'un too, beats the outside edge of the bat
shorter in length and pushed to the off side for a single
and that's a single to the fine-leg fielder, it was very full and he was going for a full-bloodied flick there, straight to the fielder
shorter in length, bit of movement away from the bat and pushed down the ground for a single
on his pads, good length ball too and easily tucked it away to the leg side for a single
short of length, pushed back to the bowler, not for runs
shorter in length and that's pulled away for a four, good, good shot!
another shorter ball and he isn't averse to pulling it away, does it well, gets it away to the fielder for a single
shorter in length, pushed to the off side this time, jams his bat down in time
short of length and pulled away to the leg side for a four, that's a very well-played shot from Pathan, powered away!
and that's played very fine, through to the third-man region, opening the face of the bat and through to fielder
short of length from the bowler and it's punched to the off side, straight to the short cover fielder
short of length and that's punched down the ground for a single
full-toss on the off stump and it's driven to the short cover fielder
on his pads and tucked away to the leg side for a single this time
slower in pace and on a good length and he pats it back to the bowler
very full this time and it's dug out well by the batsman, pushed down the ground for a single
slower in pace, shorter in length and very calmly played away to the off side
on his pads and that's patted away to long-on for a single
shortens his length and tucked away to the leg side for a single
down the leg side and signalled a wide, although he was moving across to the off stump, he was looking to glance it away, almost hits his pads
shorter in length and outside the off stump, that's punched down to long-off for a single
fuller on the middle stump and that's tucked away to the leg side for a single
shorter in length from Sid and he's played it away to the leg side
slower one from the bowler and it's pushed down to deep mid-wicket for a single
short of length and this has been crashed away through backward point for a four, beats the point fieldsman, beats the third-man and that's gone away
short of length and pulled away to deep square-leg for a single
and shortens his length just that little ball from the previous one, beats the outside edge of the bat
fuller and he hits it on the full too, straight to the backward point fielder though
and now Kallis opens the face of the bat to guide it to the short third-man fielder
shorter in length and it's tapped to mid-wicket for a single
swing back into the batsman as he was looking to play it down to third-man again, the nip back cramps him up a tad
cut away easily to the deep point region for a single
now he's bowling it shorter than what he would like, opens the face of the bat and pushes it to the off side for a single
shorter this time from the bowler and he nudges it to the off side for a quick single
swept away for a big, big six! that's fuller again and he's had no difficulty in cracking it away for a maximum
full-toss from Hogg and that's hit over mid-wicket, not hit too well and it goes away for a single
fuller on the off and he defends it off the front foot, played away to the short cover fielder
fuller from him now, and he's defended it off the front foot, back to the bowler
looking to open the face of the bat but does not get any bat on it
he tries to repeat that open-batted stroke through third-man, this time there's a fielder positioned there
on the middle stump, pushed down to long-on for a single
on his pads and that's flicked away to the fine-leg area for a single
picked up and hit over long-on for a six! that's a good shot, gone all the way, was on a length and does well to send it away
on his pads, flicked away to the leg side for a single
and that's played away through the third-man region for a four, this was what he was attempting previous delivery and that's gone to the fence
fuller on the off stump and that's pushed into the off side, not for runs
on his pads and that's flicked away to the leg side, it was in the air but no-one near the shot
well played and well fielder, short of length and he's looking to open the face of the bat and get it through the third-man, a diving Binny stops it
on the off stump and that's pushed to the off stump, good length ball
good delivery, wrong 'un, beats the outside edge and the bails are whipped away quickly too, but he's inside his crease
another full-toss, on the middle stump and the pull goes away to the deep square-leg region for a single
fuller on the off stump and this is driven down to long-off for a single
down the leg side, almost a full-toss and swept away to the leg side for a single
full-toss on the off stump, pushed down the ground for a single
whoa, that's some shot, Hogg floated it up to the bat and he's gone inside out and against the turn, over cover and for a six!
round the stumps and slower, pushed to the off side but not for runs
shortens his length and he cuts it through the short third-man region where Dravid misfields! that was a straightforward one!
and spanked it away! fuller outside the off, some room to free his arms and he does exactly that, six over the bowler's head
fullish on the middle stump and driven to long-off for a single
wants to go after the bowler, first ball too, gets a bit of an inside edge to fine-leg for a single

and he's gone now, Chavan's taken a good one at short cover! it was flighted up to the bat and he was looking to work it down to the leg side, gets a leading edge and it flies to the off side where Rahane takes a good catch going forward
on his pads and tucked away to the fine-leg region for a single
fuller on the middle stump, turning back into the batsman, flicked away to the leg side for a single
down the leg side and he was looking to sweep it away, the ump's given it runs first before the batsman shakes his head and says he's not touched it and then...he gives it a wide!
goes for the sweep this time, it was a wrong 'un and a touch shorter too, beats him
on the off stump and its paddled away by Bisla over the short fine-leg region for a couple of overs
another one that's right up to the bat and he gets his pad out and drives it to the long-off fielder
fuller from over the wicket and driven back to the bowler
fuller and on the off stump, driven to the mid-off fielder, not for runs
down the leg side, was on his pads and he gets something on it through to the very fine fine-leg fence for a four, not the best of deliveries there
on the middle stump and on a good length, it's tapped to the leg side and boy it runs away to the fence, almost makes it there too but dived and fielded well by Binny

appeal for a stumping against Gambhir! it was on a length and he was looking to play it inside out, he missed and the keeper collects and whips them off almost at the same time, it was the quickest pieces of works I have seen in a long time against a quickish bowler like Watson, Gambhir had his foot out and the third ump gives it out!
fuller on the middle stump and he drives it back to the bowler, fielded well
changes his line and it's outside the off stump, driven to the covers, straight to the fielder
down the leg side for a wide, that definitely swung down, was on the leg stump and it's eluded the bat, collected well
the keeper's up to the stumps and the ball's right up to the bat, pushes it back to the bowler
goes over the top and for a four! he's gone down the track and hit it over the mid-off fielder with ease, four more
fuller on the off stump, and he pushes it back to the bowler, again, not for a run
on the off stump, short of length, to the point fielder, not for runs
opens the face of the bat and guides it to the off side for a single
on a length and outside the off stump, pushed it to the off side
fuller on the middle stump and pushed back to the bowler, fielded and no run, that's a costly over
and now defended to the off side and cries of "no, no, no" from the batsman
and that's midfielded by Chavan at point, it was a full-toss and placed into the off side, should have been fielded there, he dives over the ball

goes down the track and wants to slog it over the leg side but this one takes the edge of the bat and flies over the off side, Faulkner made a diving effort to take the catch but that's quite far, and it rolls away to the fence too
on his pads and that's flicked away easily to the deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs
fuller and bit of movement away, just that little bit, and tapped down to mid-off
round the stumps and on the middle stump, he is able to tuck it to deep square-leg and they are able to come back for the second
fuller on his pads and that's flicked away to the short fine-leg fielder for a single
defended off the front foot to the off side, not for runs
down the track and crashed it over long-on for a six! it was fuller too and the batsman has no hesitation in going after it, gets it off the middle
and he continues with that same line outside the leg stump, GG gets something on it and it's gone to short fine-leg for a single
on his pads and tapped away to short fine-leg
fuller on the off stump, finally gets the line right with his slower one and driven to the short cover fielder
slower one and on the pads, easily tucked away to the leg side for a single
good, good shot, it was hit on the up and it pierces the in-field on the off side, through point for a four, slight width too
inside edged on to the pads, was looking to run it down to the third-man, but gets an edge
outside the leg stump from over the wicket, hits his pad and rolls over to the leg side for a single leg-bye
slower one on his pads straightaway and it's pushed to the deep square-leg for a single
fuller on the leg-stump line and driven down to long-on for a single to end a good first over for the KKR
he was looking to go inside out, gets an inside edge and it flies to short mid-wicket for a single
and it's on a length not too much turn and it's swept away to the backward square-leg fence for a four
goes down the track and defends, hits the pads, GG wanted the single but is sent back
fuller on his pads, was looking to play it out to the leg side, gets a leading edge back to the bowler
goes down the track and driven through the leg side for a single
round the stumps, on the leg stump line and turned away, given wide
